info.description:
REST API for managing books, editions and download links.

## Authentication

Every request needs an API key in the header `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`.
Keys are created in the admin area under **Settings → API keys** and are shown in full
only once. Keys in the URL are rejected.

| Permission | Allows |
|---|---|
| `books:read` | Read books, editions and statistics |
| `books:write` | Create, edit, archive and delete books; publish editions |
| `files:write` | Upload or remove PDF, EPUB and cover |
| `links:manage` | Create, list, check, change and revoke download links |

## Idempotency

`POST /books`, the upload endpoints and `POST /links` accept the header
`Idempotency-Key` (16 to 200 characters, ideally a random UUID). Repeating a request with the
same key and the same content within 24 hours returns the original response with the header
`Idempotent-Replayed: true` and creates no duplicate.
The same key with different content is rejected with 422.

## Download links

The secret code and the full URL of a link are returned **only** in the response to
`POST /links`. Only a hash is stored; lists and detail requests never contain
the code.

## Editions

A new book automatically gets a draft for edition 1. Files are uploaded into a
draft; published editions are immutable. When publishing a further edition,
`existing_links` must be explicitly `migrate` or `keep` as soon as the book has
download links.

## Errors

Errors always have the form `{"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "fields": [...]}}`.
